title: Recovery, control and progressive power.
body: The blank is being developed to recover quickly after the cast, resist unwanted torsional movement and load progressively through the working section. The objective is not a harsh rod. It is a controlled offshore tool that remains responsive while carrying sustained pressure.

features.title: Fast recovery
features.body: Rapid blank recovery supports lure control, casting accuracy and reduced oscillation after release.

features.title: Progressive loading
features.body: Power develops through the working section rather than concentrating force abruptly in one area.

features.title: Torsional stability
features.body: Guide alignment, blank construction and component placement work together to resist unwanted twist.

features.title: Offshore durability
features.body: Impact resistance and wall consistency remain part of the development target alongside reduced finished weight.

closing_line: Crisp enough to cast. Progressive enough to fight.
